t: Gardener check frequency should scale with user attention — active spokes get tended more often
description: The gardener currently checks all spokes on a fixed schedule. But user attention is a signal: a spoke with 4 hours of activity today needs more frequent tending (signal routing, health checks, teaching distribution) than one untouched for a week. The attention-as-metric from the PEV fractal signal should drive gardener scheduling. Hot spokes get checked more often. Cold spokes get checked less. This is the gardener PEVing its own work schedule.
implications: Gardener needs access to session duration per spoke (from hub session aggregation)
Define attention tiers: hot (active today), warm (active this week), cold (>7 days)
Hot spokes: check every gardener run. Cold spokes: check weekly.
This makes gardener resources scale with actual usage, not fixed schedule
